mountpoint.description: Local directory where the iOS media/root is mounted.

udid.description: UDID of the specific iOS device to mount. Empty string mounts the first attached device.

network.description: If true, connects to the device over network.

root.description: If true, mounts the root filesystem (jailbroken only).
